title: Junior Data Scincetist
description: Job Requirements Role: To contribute to the end-to-end development and product lifecycle management of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) systems as part of an R&D organization. The Junior Data Scientist supports the definition of intended algorithm performance, the development and curation of representative data and annotations, the development of AI/ML algorithms, and the generation of scientific evidence demonstrating stand-alone algorithm performance. The candidate is expected to: Apply scientific, statistical, machine learning, and software engineering methods to develop and evaluate AI/ML algorithm components for defined product use cases. Work with experienced Data Scientists, product management, clinical or domain experts, software developers, and quality and regulatory functions to translate customer needs and the intended use into measurable algorithm performance targets. Support the definition, sourcing, curation, documentation, and maintenance of representative data cohorts and annotations required for training, tuning, and evaluation. Plan and execute reproducible scientific evaluations that provide objective evidence of algorithm performance, limitations, and suitability for the intended use. Contribute the Data Science work products and evidence required for integration of AI/ML algorithm components into products and for their verification, validation, regulatory release, and lifecycle monitoring. What are my responsibilities? As a Junior Data Scientist, you are required to: Support the finalization of product and algorithm concepts by translating customer needs, intended use, clinical or technical requirements, and applicable regulatory considerations into measurable state-of-the-art performance targets. Contribute to the definition of the AI/ML development and scientific evaluation strategy for assigned algorithm components under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists. Perform exploratory data analysis and data risk assessments to identify data gaps, quality issues, potential bias, confounding factors, outliers, and limitations that may affect algorithm development or evaluation. Define and document data needs for training, tuning, and evaluation, including relevant subgroups and acceptance criteria, so that data cohorts are representative of the intended use and aligned with the product and regulatory strategy. Support the specification of annotations, acceptance criteria, and quality controls; collaborate with qualified internal or external suppliers on sourcing data and annotations. Curate, version, maintain, and document representative data cohorts and ensure data provenance, traceability, quality, and fitness for purpose together with data management stakeholders. Design, implement, train, tune, and technically characterize AI/ML algorithm components using appropriate machine learning, deep learning, statistical, or generative AI methods. Define scientifically justified metrics, evaluation methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria to assess stand-alone algorithm performance, including relevant aspects such as accuracy, robustness, reliability, generalizability, explainability, bias, and subgroup performance. Implement and execute reproducible bench tests on representative evaluation cohorts and relevant subgroups as part of the verification and validation strategy. Analyze and interpret evaluation results, investigate failure modes, document residual limitations, and derive evidence-based recommendations for algorithm improvement and product decisions. Document development and evaluation activities and contribute to Data Science work products such as data management information, annotation specifications, scientific evaluation test cases, and scientific evaluation reports. Provide scientific evidence and technical input for product reviews and regulatory submissions and support responses to questions concerning data, annotations, evaluation methods, and stand-alone algorithm performance. Support the design and execution of clinical investigations, reader studies, or other studies when additional evidence is required by the product or regulatory strategy. Collaborate with software engineering and MLOps functions to establish reproducible pipelines, versioned artifacts, automated tests, controlled deployment, and integration of algorithm components into the product. Help define and implement monitoring metrics for detecting data anomalies, outliers, and algorithm performance drift across the product lifecycle. Regularly review advances in Data Science and AI and assess their applicability to the development and evaluation of AI/ML products. Qualification: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering, Medical Informatics, or a related quantitative or engineering field. A Ph.D. is welcome but not required. The candidate should have completed university-level coursework or equivalent practical training in: Probability, statistics, and experimental design Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning Linear algebra, optimization, and numerical methods Data structures, algorithms, and software programming Model evaluation, scientific methodology, and interpretation of empirical results Experience level: This is a junior R&D position. Relevant experience may have been gained through academic research, a thesis, internships, working-student assignments, or up to approximately three years of professional work in Data Science, machine learning, AI research, or AI/ML product development. Demonstrated hands-on experience in developing and scientifically evaluating AI/ML models is more important than a specific number of years. Desired Knowledge & Experience: Sound understanding of machine learning, deep learning, statistical analysis, experimental design, and model evaluation. Active programming skills in Python and practical experience with libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras. Hands-on experience with the development workflow of AI/ML models, including data preparation, training, tuning, evaluation, error analysis, reproducibility, and documentation. Ability to define meaningful performance metrics, evaluation cohorts, subgroup analyses, test methods, and acceptance criteria for the intended use of an AI/ML algorithm. Understanding of data quality, representativeness, bias, annotation quality, data provenance, and traceability in AI/ML development. Knowledge of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) concepts and tooling, including source and data versioning, reproducible pipelines, experiment tracking, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring. Hands-on exposure to current Large Language Models and Generative AI, including foundation models, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and model adaptation or fine-tuning. Knowledge of Agentic AI, including tool-using models, multi-step workflows, orchestration, memory, and autonomous or semi-autonomous decision paths, is an advantage. Experience or strong interest in the systematic evaluation of LLM, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including task-specific benchmarks, groundedness and factuality, robustness, reproducibility, human evaluation, safety and guardrail testing, tool-use correctness, and analysis of failure modes. Experience with databases and query languages such as SQL; knowledge of Kusto Query Language, Snowflake, or graph databases such as Neo4j is an advantage. Exposure to cloud-based data and AI environments, preferably Microsoft Azure, such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Monitor, or Azure DevOps. Experience with structured and unstructured data, for example machine logs, event data, Parquet files, text data, or multimodal data. Knowledge of healthcare, medical technology, clinical data, or interoperability standards such as DICOM is preferred. Basic project management skills and familiarity with working in cross-functional R&D or product-development teams. Required Soft Skills & Other Capabilities: Scientific mindset, strong analytical ability, and attention to detail. Commitment to objective evidence, reproducibility, traceability, data integrity, and responsible AI development. Curiosity and resilience to investigate unexpected results, challenge assumptions, and improve models based on evidence. Collaborative approach to working with Data Scientists, domain experts, software engineers, product management, and quality and regulatory stakeholders. Ability to work independently within an agreed scope and to seek guidance when technical, scientific, product, or regulatory implications require alignment. Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain methods, results, uncertainties, limitations, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description: Location Bengaluru Employment Type Full time Location Type On-site Department Engineering About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. About the Role We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to set technical direction and lead hands-on security work across CodeRabbit’s products, cloud infrastructure, identities, and AI systems. You’ll think like an attacker, build practical defenses, and partner with engineering, platform, and IT teams to reduce risk as we scale. This is a senior individual contributor role with company-wide influence. You’ll turn ambiguous security problems into prioritized engineering work, lead complex initiatives from design through rollout, and mentor engineers. Your impact will come from durable improvements to architecture, access controls, detection coverage, and incident readiness, as well as finding and fixing vulnerabilities. What You’ll Do Define and drive the technical security roadmap with engineering leaders, prioritizing work by customer impact, threat exposure, and business needs. Establish clear ownership and measure whether controls reduce risk. Lead threat modeling and security architecture reviews for products, infrastructure, and major design changes. Build reusable patterns, guardrails, and automated checks that make secure development easier. Improve cloud security across GCP, GKE/Kubernetes, and serverless workloads, covering network isolation, workload identity, secrets management, encryption and key management, container security, and infrastructure-as-code controls. Lead identity and access management improvements for people, services, and automation: least privilege, SSO/MFA, privileged and time-bound access, service accounts, credential lifecycle management, access reviews, and joiner/mover/leaver controls. Partner with IT and platform teams on implementation. Build and operate security detection capabilities using cloud audit logs, identity events, application telemetry, and endpoint signals. Develop and test SIEM detections, tune alerts, investigate suspicious activity, and improve visibility into credential misuse and unauthorized access. Lead technical incident response for complex security events, from triage and investigation through containment, eradication, and recovery. Maintain playbooks, run exercises, coordinate with stakeholders, and drive root-cause fixes and post-incident improvements. Plan and execute authorized offensive assessments, red team exercises, and adversary emulation across applications, APIs, cloud, and enterprise environments. Define scope and rules of engagement, validate impact safely, and turn findings into fixes and tested detections. Assess AI and agentic-system risks, including prompt injection, tool and connector abuse, excessive agent permissions, RAG/vector-store poisoning, sensitive-data leakage, and trust boundaries between models, tools, and workloads. Build security tooling and automation in Python, Go, or similar languages. Integrate preventive controls and security testing into CI/CD and work with engineers to validate remediation. Improve vulnerability management and bug bounty or responsible disclosure triage, focusing on exploitability, remediation ownership, timelines, and recurring weaknesses. Mentor engineers, lead cross-team technical decisions, and communicate security tradeoffs clearly to engineering leaders and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with compliance teams to ensure documented controls reflect how systems actually operate. You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You Have Typically 8+ years of relevant security engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated depth and impact, with a track record of leading complex initiatives across teams as a senior technical individual contributor. Strong hands-on cloud and infrastructure security experience, including Kubernetes, networking, secrets and key management, and infrastructure as code. Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider; GCP experience is particularly relevant. Practical IAM expertise across workforce and workload identities, including least-privilege design, federation, service accounts, privileged access, credential management, and investigation of identity-based attacks. Experience building and validating security detections, working with SIEM and cloud audit telemetry, and investigating incidents. Ability to lead response under pressure and translate lessons into lasting engineering improvements. Strong application and offensive security skills, demonstrated through impactful internal findings, penetration tests, vulnerability research, responsible disclosures, bug bounty work, or security tooling. Strong programming and automation skills, with the ability to build maintainable tools and contribute directly to production code and infrastructure changes. Ability to reason through attack chains and system trust boundaries, use frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK where useful, and balance preventive controls, detection, and response. Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, influence architecture without direct authority, mentor engineers, and deliver measurable improvements across organizational boundaries. Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to explain risk and practical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to Have Experience securing AI/ML, LLM, RAG, or multi-agent systems, including OWASP guidance for LLM applications and AI red-team practices. Experience securing developer platforms, source-code integrations, CI/CD pipelines, software supply chains, and customer credentials or tokens. Experience with threat hunting, digital forensics, endpoint security, and detection-as-code workflows. Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls through engineering automation and evidence collection. Contributions to security research, open-source tooling, responsible disclosure communities, or conference talks. Relevant practical certifications are a plus, not a substitute for demonstrated impact. Our Values Collaborative Humans : Prioritizing collective intelligence Fearless Innovators : Turning obstacles into growth opportunities Persistent, Passionate Developers : Thriving on complex, long-term challenges Impact-Driven Creators : Crafting intuitive tools for developers Rapid Learners and Un-learners : Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world What We Offer Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact Collaborative and innovative environment Competitive salary, equity, and benefits Professional development opportunities To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

How we work Our security team spans the United States, Romania, and India and protects the platforms that banks and wealth managers rely on every day. We hold a high bar, and we hold it together. The people on this team own their work from start to finish, keep learning because they want to, and make the people around them better. We do not reward the loudest voice in the room. title: Senior Data QE Engineer, Hyderabad-based
description: Client: Our client is a global organization focused on professional education and certification. Project overview: The client runs a large application landscape and the analytical datasets behind it. Data moves from PostgreSQL sources on AWS into Snowflake through orchestrated pipelines. Quality for that data is part of delivery: test design, checks on movement and transformation, quality metrics, and practical help when data has to be corrected. Data QE engineers own that hands-on work for data moving from source systems into analytical datasets, from test design through execution, investigation, and release-readiness reporting. Position overview: We are looking for a Senior Data QE Engineer with solid experience in ETL testing and data validation, and strong SQL skills. You will design and run data quality tests, validate pipelines end to end, reconcile source and analytical data, and give engineering and business teams evidence for release decisions. You will also automate comparisons in Python, work with Airflow pipeline runs, and use AWS and Grafana to observe pipeline health. You will use an AI coding assistant to analyze data and author SQL, Python, and quality checks, and you will review generated output before it is used. This position is intended for Hyderabad-based candidates who are available to work from the office. Technology stack: SQL, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora, Python, pytest, Airflow, AWS, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, EKS, Grafana, GitHub, GitHub Actions, TestRail, Jira, AI coding assistants, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, dbt Responsibilities: Own data quality for data moving from source systems into analytical datasets, from test design through execution, investigation, and reporting. Design, implement, and execute data quality tests, and publish quality metrics and dashboards that producing and consuming groups can use. Validate pipelines end to end, covering movement, transformation, completeness, history, freshness, and compliance. Write reconciliation, drift, and quality SQL on Snowflake layered models (raw, history, silver, and gold), including slowly changing dimensions and merge behavior. Validate PostgreSQL sources with consistent snapshot counts and checks that logical replication kept the expected data. Use logical and physical data models and data contracts to assess downstream impact and set quality coverage. Automate data comparison and reconciliation in Python with pytest, and keep the checks in GitHub. Trigger pipeline runs in Airflow and read task results into the quality verdict. Investigate quality issues and support remediation with the groups that produce and consume the data. Design failover, outage, and volume tests and judge the evidence, including recovery time and recovery point. The platform team executes destructive and chaos tests. Run read-only checks in pre-production and production. Integrate quality checks with CI/CD on GitHub Actions or an equivalent tool. Use AWS and Grafana to observe pipeline health, including CloudWatch metrics, secrets metadata, and container platform state. Check classification, masking, and retention against the stated data rules. Track defects to closure in Jira and keep test cases and results in TestRail. Provide quality evidence, risks, and readiness input for releases. Use an AI coding assistant to analyze data and author SQL, Python, and quality checks, and review generated output before it is used. Requirements: Senior-level data quality engineering experience in ETL testing and data validation. Strong SQL and Snowflake data-modelling experience, including layered raw, history, silver, and gold models, reconciliation and drift queries, and slowly changing dimensions and merge behavior. Experience with logical and physical data models and with assessing the downstream impact of schema and data-contract changes. Experience validating PostgreSQL sources, including consistent snapshot counts and logical replication. Hands-on Python automation for data comparison and reconciliation, using pytest or an equivalent framework. Experience running and reading orchestrated pipelines in Airflow or an equivalent scheduler. Experience validating data movement, transformation, completeness, history, freshness, and compliance from source systems into analytical datasets. Experience diagnosing data quality issues and supporting remediation. Experience integrating data quality checks with CI/CD using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools. Experience with test management and defect tracking in TestRail and Jira. Working knowledge of AWS and Grafana for pipeline observation, including CloudWatch, secrets management, and container platforms. Experience designing resilience tests and judging evidence for failover, outage, volume, and recovery objectives. Working knowledge of data classification, masking, and retention checks. Experience producing data quality metrics, reports, and dashboards. Experience with risk-based testing in Agile or Kanban teams. Hands-on use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent) to author SQL, Python, and quality checks, with human review of generated output. Ability to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders. Experience providing quality evidence, risks, and readiness input for releases. Nice to have: Experience observing Snowflake Openflow or NiFi connector state well enough to recognize a stalled load. Experience with custom cross-table data quality checks that publish results for dashboarding. Familiarity with GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows for maintaining data quality checks. Familiarity with RAG and MCP concepts for QE tooling and for generating test data. Knowledge of AI-driven test optimization and coverage analytics (SeaLights or equivalent). Experience with service virtualization using WireMock or an equivalent tool, so checks can run when a dependency is unavailable. Experience specifying and reviewing dbt tests.
